title: Pixagram Announces Free Account Creation for 250 New Users Daily Through 2026
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – Panama City, Panama, October 15th, 2026] Pixagram announces free account creation for up to 250 new members daily through the end of 2026. Built on the standalone Layer-1 Pixa blockchain, Pixagram is an anti-hierarchy social network where every post, vote, and comment is recorded as a signed on-chain transaction, with no ads […]
